title: Coolie Box Office Day 7: Rajinikanth Starrer Struggles, But Crosses Rs 200 Crore-Mark | Tamil Cinema News - News18
text: Rajinikanth’s much-awaited film Coolie marked the superstar’s 50 years in cinema. The movie opened with great numbers at the Indian box office, as it managed to pull huge crowds over the Independence Day holiday weekend. However, after the initial buzz, the action-packed thriller began to lose momentum. By the end of its first week, the film had impressively crossed the Rs 200 crore mark, but the daily earnings painted a different picture. Monday witnessed a steep drop, Tuesday fell further, and Day 7 followed the same declining trend. Coolie Day 7 Box Office According to Sacnilk, the Tamil movie collected Rs 6.50 crore on its seventh day, and the total box office figure reached Rs 222 crore. On Wednesday, the film saw mixed occupancies across different regions and languages. In Tamil, where Rajinikanth has the biggest fan base, the film recorded an overall occupancy of 20.97%. In Hindi, the occupancy was lower at 11.69%. Meanwhile, the Telugu version managed to get 16.48% occupancy. Coolie opened with a thunderous response as it earned Rs 65 crore on Day 1. The momentum continued on Day 2 with Rs 54.75 crore, and Day 3 brought in Rs 39.5 crore, keeping the numbers high over the holiday weekend. On Day 4, the film collected Rs 35.25 crore, but the earnings fell drastically to Rs 12 crore on Day 5, followed by another dip with Rs 9.5 crore on Day 6. Clash With War 2 Despite stiff competition from Hrithik Roshan and Jr NTR’s War 2, which has earned Rs 199 crore so far, Rajinikanth’s Coolie continues to lead the race. With a box office collection of Rs 222 crore, the film stands as yet another testament to the superstar’s unmatched screen presence. Coolie tells the story of Deva, played by Rajinikanth, a former union leader who uncovers the truth behind the sudden death of his close friend Rajasekhar. His search for justice pulls him into a dangerous clash with powerful gangster Simon, played by Nagarjuna and his right-hand man. Alongside Rajinikanth, the film also stars Shruti Haasan, Rachita Ram, Upendra and Aamir Khan playing key roles. While critics have shared mixed opinions about the film’s plot, the energy, style and screen presence of Rajinikanth have been loved by his fans.
